results.content: Four-Year Guarantee St. Norbert College offers a Four-Year Graduation Guarantee to students who meet the following conditions: ●​ Enroll in 16 semester credits per term for eight consecutive semesters ●​ Do not fail or withdraw from any courses ●​ Maintain a minimum cumulative GPA of 2.00 ●​ Declare a major before the start of the third year (fifth semester) ●​ Apply for financial aid and be approved for the guarantee by the Registrar This guarantee reflects the strength of the college’s academic advising, the flexibility of its curriculum, and its commitment to affordable, timely degree completion.
